what_survives_and_is_a_DIFFERENT_claim.statement: at MATCHED quality, Scaffold Medium is 6.2x (HE+) / 8.2x (MBPP+) cheaper in forward passes than DreamOn at canvas=32
what_survives_and_is_a_DIFFERENT_claim.caveat: this is a COST result at matched quality, not the QUALITY result A05 registered. Still bounded above by AR (.707/.680). Needs its own proposal + gates; must NOT be smuggled in under A05's registered claim.

corrections_to_the_record: The archived nfe is NOT a forward-pass count even where non-null: the driver logged len(output.history), and _sample appends to history after the transfer step AND after delete batches AND after expand batches (up to ~3x model calls), plus it is None when output_history=False (hence r2's nfe:null). PROPOSAL.md section 1's 'NFE mean 265.9/135.7' and the derived '4.17x/2.39x cheaper' are wrong. True counted NFE at the archived setting: 172.3 (HE+) / 153.4 (MBPP+).

mask_expansion/delete_eos_token confirmed inert BY EXECUTION: GenerationConfig.update() returns them as unused kwargs and the attrs never exist. Consequence: _run_baselines_r2_wzc1.sh's header comment claiming these as round-2 'fixes' describes a fix that never took effect.

NEW BUG -- HE+ stitch: combine_humaneval_prompt() indents raw output by 4 spaces when it has no top-level def, but DreamOn already emits a 4-space-indented body -> double indent -> SyntaxError. 113 of 117 unparseable HE+ items at canvas=128 are caused by this; a dedent-aware stitch restores 158/164. Shared with the archive so comparability holds, but HE+ pass@1 at large canvases is UNDERSTATED, which strengthens K1.

PROPOSAL.md section 4's cost estimate (~14 GPU-h for 10 cells) was low: 5 cells cost 20.66 GPU-h billed. Cause = shard stragglers hitting DreamOn's own iteration cap (~2060 forwards / ~200 s) while the median item finishes in <1 s.
